name: moyarich-console-workspace

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @moyarich/console-core && npm run build --workspace @moyarich/console && npm run build --workspace @moyarich/console-addon-imperative-scrolling && npm run build --workspace @moyarich/console-addon-data-export && npm run build --workspace @moyarich/console-addon-diagnostics && npm run build --workspace @moyarich/console-addon-resizable && npm run build --workspace @moyarich/console-playground
scripts.build:package: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @moyarich/console
scripts.build:addons: npm run build --workspace @moyarich/console-addon-imperative-scrolling && npm run build --workspace @moyarich/console-addon-data-export && npm run build --workspace @moyarich/console-addon-diagnostics && npm run build --workspace @moyarich/console-addon-resizable

description: Workspace for @moyarich/console, a React console and ANSI process-output UI for embedded developer tools.
